meta.name: Registry and manifests

sectionLabels.step: steps that write and read them

meta.about: The manifests HAX generates about its own elements, from the webcomponents source: wc-registry.json: 614 tags, 609 of them HAX packages; wc-registry-graph.json: 614 tags over 1167 module paths; custom-elements.json: 139 packages declare 274 elements; elements-catalog.json: 602 elements, 166 HAX can author; hax-elements-registry.json: 187 authorable tags; translation-manifest.json: 149 of 234 elements translated, 41,015 files, 104 languages; languages.json: 134 languages. Steps are read from the ubiquity build and each element's build script; readers are found by scanning the built packages and the backends.

registry.desc: The generated files that tell HAX which elements exist, where each loads from, what each declares and which languages each speaks: 7 kinds of manifest, written by the ubiquity build and the cem analyzer, read by 6 packages and tools.

m_wcregistry.desc: Every tag the autoloader can load, mapped to the module that defines it. Copied into each HAXcms build and site. Today: 614 tags, 609 of them HAX packages.

m_wcgraph.desc: The import graph behind the registry, so a page can preload what a tag will pull in. Today: 614 tags over 1167 module paths.

m_cem.desc: The Custom Elements Manifest of a package: its elements' properties, attributes, events, slots and CSS parts, written by cem analyze. Today: 139 packages declare 274 elements.

m_catalog.desc: One entry per element (tag, title, package, import, whether HAX can author it) for search: hax wc --search. Today: 602 elements, 166 HAX can author.

m_haxreg.desc: The tags HAX can author, with their display titles. Today: 187 authorable tags.

m_translations.desc: Which elements ship which locale files, scanned from every element's locales folder. Today: 149 of 234 elements translated, 41,015 files, 104 languages.

m_languages.desc: The languages HAX offers, with their names and direction; kept in sync wherever it is copied. Today: 134 languages.
m_languages.note: Kept by hand at its source; language-registry-sync copies it out.

st_wc_autoloader.desc: Step 6 of the ubiquity build. Writes wc-registry.json, wc-registry-graph.json.

st_language_registry_sync.desc: Step 8 of the ubiquity build. Copies languages.json into the backends and the CLI.

st_hax_elements_discovery.desc: Step 9 of the ubiquity build. Writes hax-elements-registry.json.

st_elements_catalog.desc: Step 10 of the ubiquity build. Writes elements-catalog.json. Reads custom-elements.json, hax-elements-registry.json.

st_hax_elements_demo_page.desc: Step 11 of the ubiquity build. Reads wc-registry.json, hax-elements-registry.json.

st_translation_manifest.desc: Step 13 of the ubiquity build. Writes translation-manifest.json.

st_language_registry_report.desc: Step 14 of the ubiquity build. Reads translation-manifest.json, languages.json.

sc_api_snapshot.desc: A script outside the ubiquity build. Reads custom-elements.json, hax-elements-registry.json.

sc_build_component_gallery.desc: A script outside the ubiquity build. Reads wc-registry.json.

sc_extract_element_docs.desc: A script outside the ubiquity build. Reads custom-elements.json.

sc_gallery_dev_server.desc: A script outside the ubiquity build. Reads wc-registry.json.

sc_i18n_layout_check.desc: A script outside the ubiquity build. Reads hax-elements-registry.json.

sc_knip_report.desc: A script outside the ubiquity build. Reads wc-registry.json.

sc_leak_check.desc: A script outside the ubiquity build. Reads hax-elements-registry.json.

st_cem_analyze.desc: Run by the build script of 226 element packages; 139 commit the result. Writes custom-elements.json.

nodejs.desc: Reads wc-registry.json in app.js, lib/HAXCMS.js, lib/linearText.js and more; wc-registry-graph.json in app.js, lib/HAXCMS.js; languages.json in lib/languageRegistry.js.

php.desc: Reads languages.json in php/lib/LanguageRegistry.php, php/lib/LocalizationSettingsService.php, php/lib/operations/languages.php; wc-registry.json in php/lib/HAXCMS.php, php/lib/HAXCMSSite.php, php/lib/operations/downloadSite.php and more; wc-registry-graph.json in php/lib/HAXCMS.php, php/lib/HAXCMSSite.php.

cli.desc: Reads wc-registry.json in create.js, lib/programs/audit-ssr.js, lib/programs/site.js and more; languages.json in lib/language-registry.js; custom-elements.json in lib/programs/site.js, lib/programs/webcomponent.js; elements-catalog.json in lib/programs/webcomponent.js.

pk_haxcms_elements.desc: Reads wc-registry.json in lib/core/haxcms-site-builder.js; wc-registry-graph.json in lib/core/haxcms-site-builder.js.

pk_i18n_manager.desc: Reads translation-manifest.json in i18n-manager.js; languages.json in lib/LanguageRegistry.js.

pk_web_container.desc: Reads wc-registry.json in lib/web-container-wc-registry-docs.js; custom-elements.json in lib/web-container-doc-player.js.

tours.label: How HAX knows its own elements
tours.message: 7 manifests, 7 ubiquity steps that touch them, 6 readers.

scenes.caption: The registry: where every tag loads from, and the import graph behind it.
Each package describes its elements in a Custom Elements Manifest; the catalog and HAX's registry are built from them.
Translations: which languages exist and which elements speak them.
The ubiquity build writes them in order.
